items.scientificClaim: 在修正白化基线上，81920 个分区细胞中 51520 个可评价、30400 个几何球外、0 个未决；20 个交集相对修正 `4⁴` 全部进一步收紧，中位增量宽度比 0.587495，最大减少 0.046398005。640 次顶点评价中 44 个可行候选、596 个球外见证，200 次候选及 200 次网格检查通过。
items.limitations: 增量序列不是渐近收敛或全局最优证明，平台为 0 不排除后续平台。球外顶点不冒充可行极值；原始代数端点与正确分母必须保留，第 5 折继续不可用。Grid-4/grid-8 ratios describe this frozen refinement sequence only and are not asymptotic errors, convergence proofs or global optima The whitened cover contains points outside the ball; outer vertices are not feasible extrema unless their norm and denominator pass the gates Unresolved denominator cells remain unresolved and produce unbounded unions, never finite reciprocal or vertex witnesses Fold 5 has no certified negative denominator and receives no cells, candidates, vertex witnesses or finite residual bounds The 200 transform witnesses, grid-8 candidate checks and vertex witnesses are consistency evidence, not a substitute for full cell coverage or an independent experiment High-precision outward-rounded intervals are not exact rational certificates or probability regions
items.upstreamContribution: 提供流式 `8⁴` 网格、修正白化基线、原始代数端点、几何球外计数、增量宽度与顶点可行性接口，并保留三份协议修订和失效旧基线说明。
